ownership: Official Texas Active Franchise Taxpayers administrative records published by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts through the State of Texas Open Data Portal
license_status: The catalog metadata does not state a license. Record-level use and redistribution require an explicit rights review before any broader publication.
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS Socrata metadata and count endpoints. This connector does not request row data.
allowed_use: read-only retrieval of exact official dataset metadata
read-only count(*) query that returns no taxpayer records
immutable local retention of metadata/count preflight receipts
schema-drift and scale assessment before a separately authorized acquisition
after a separate rights review, implemented large-acquisition approval, and exact acknowledgement: local organization and franchise-tax-status normalization
after a separately governed row acquisition: exact taxpayer-number reconciliation only
prohibited_use: requesting taxpayer rows through this metadata-only connector
initiating a large acquisition without the exact operator acknowledgement and a separately implemented acquisition workflow
representing a taxpayer administrative address as a physical site, storefront, service location, or geocoded operating location
creating business-entity geometry or latitude/longitude from an administrative taxpayer address
representing franchise-tax, SOS, exemption, or right-to-transact fields as independent proof of current business operation
automatically reconciling records by name, address, SOS/COA number, NAICS, or fuzzy similarity
joining ZIP5 and ZIP+4 into one canonical postal field
treating the anomalous _621111 source field name as a literal NAICS value rather than preserving and validating its NAICS Code label
record-level redistribution before an explicit license and privacy determination
attribution: Source: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, Active Franchise Taxpayers, via data.texas.gov.
retention: Retain immutable metadata/count preflight receipts. Future raw and normalized record-level artifacts, if separately authorized, remain local and versioned under their approved retention plan.
redistribution: The catalog license is null/unreported. Do not redistribute taxpayer-level source or normalized records; both remain internal or local-review-only until an explicit source-rights and privacy review authorizes a different policy.
personal_data_handling: Taxpayer names and administrative addresses can identify natural persons or residences. No rows are acquired by this connector. Any future record-level artifacts must remain local-review-only, preserve administrative-address semantics, and undergo privacy review.
